text_block_list.text:
Phew! That takes care of our first goal of
the year.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: How did you find it, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I wasn't worried in the slightest.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you. I guess this is what
they call
"smooth sailing."
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Now I can take on the Takarazuka Kinen
with my
head held high.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tamtam! Thank you for coming to
cheer me
on!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Well, I am your bestie. But friendship and races are two different things, ya hear?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Heh, I saw your—no, both you and your
trainer's
weakness real clear today.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Yup! And you're not gonna get any
better if ya
don't realize it!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Goodness! Will you tell me, Tamtam?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Say what?! Who just asks outta the blue
like
that?!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Eh, whatevs. I'll show ya next time, right
in front
of all your fans.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: A storm's brewin', so you better bring your umbrella! ...Not, like, a real storm, but... Whatever.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс leaves in an intimidating
huff.
What could our weakness be?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
